source_text: Quinta ultimaque visio Balaam. Videns Amalec: principium gentium Amalec, et semen eorum peribit.
pass_a_gloss: Fifth and-last vision of-Balaam. Seeing Amalek: beginning of-nations Amalek, and seed their will-perish.
pass_b_english: Balaam’s [[fifth and last vision >> Bible:Numbers 24:20-24]]. Seeing Amalek: [[Amalek is the first of the nations; their seed shall perish >> Bible:Numbers 24:20]].
